hero.title: Cloud Ops and Platform Engineering, for the long run.
hero.subtitle: Freelance Cloud DevOps engineer with four years on GCP and AWS. I design and evolve multi-cloud landing zones and build custom Terraform providers in Go, so your product teams can provision on their own, safely.
hero.availability: On mission at Decathlon since May 2026 · Open to discussing future missions · Remote, Paris, Lille

services.title: What I take on
services.subtitle: The scope of a typical long-term mission on a cloud platform team.

items.title: Custom Terraform providers
items.text: Custom Terraform providers in Go that bring your internal APIs and bespoke resources under infrastructure as code, tested and versioned like any other module. Built at Decathlon to industrialise network resources.

items.title: GCP and AWS landing zones
items.text: Design, operation and evolution of landing zones: organisation and accounts, networking, IAM and guardrails, shipped as reusable Terraform modules that product teams adopt on their own.

items.title: Cloud operations
items.text: Day-to-day ownership of multi-cloud environments: incident handling and root-cause analysis, L3 support and on-call, and continuous improvement of the run.

items.title: Automation and delivery
items.text: CI/CD with GitHub Actions and automated infrastructure testing with terraform test and pytest, so changes ship safely and quickly.

items.title: Internal tooling and APIs
items.text: Python and FastAPI provisioning APIs, serverless workloads on Cloud Run and internal SDKs, to remove tickets and manual steps.

items.title: Security and observability
items.text: Dependency and code scanning, secrets management with Vault, and monitoring with Datadog to keep a platform secure and observable.

items.title: AI-assisted engineering
items.text: I use AI assistants to speed up infrastructure code, APIs and tests, always with human review and automated tests before anything ships.
